# Sensaphonics

> > Sensaphonics designs and manufactures custom-molded in-ear monitors (IEMs) and hearing protection for musicians, DJs, broadcasters, and professional audio applications.

Sensaphonics specializes in custom-fit IEM systems with advanced driver technology, including active ambient monitoring capabilities. The company serves professional touring musicians, studio engineers, DJs, and broadcast professionals with tailored audio solutions.

## Key Topics

- Custom In-Ear Monitors (IEMs)
- Balanced Armature Drivers
- Active Ambient Monitoring
- Custom Ear Impressions
- Professional Audio
- Hearing Protection
- IEM Accessories & Maintenance
- Wireless IEM Systems
- Shure Integration
- DJ Audio Equipment
- Sound Isolation
- Tour Audio Systems
- Music Enhancement Technology
- Broadcasting Equipment

## Custom In-Ear Monitor Systems

- [3DME Custom Tour Gen2 Music Enhancement IEM System](https://www.sensaphonics.com/products/3dme-custom-tour-gen2-music-enhancement-iem-system): 3DME Custom Tour Gen2: active ambient IEM with quad driver option
- [3DME BT Gen2 Music Enhancement IEM System](https://www.sensaphonics.com/products/3dme-bt-gen2-music-enhancement-iem-system): 3DME BT Gen2: wireless active ambient IEM with Bluetooth control
- [2MAX Custom-Fit Earphones](https://www.sensaphonics.com/products/2max): 2MAX: most popular tour IEM with dual balanced armatures
- [3MAX Custom-Fit Earphones](https://www.sensaphonics.com/products/3max): 3MAX: bass-enhanced triple armature IEM for DJs and bassists
- [2X-S Custom-Fit Earphones](https://www.sensaphonics.com/products/2x-s): 2X-S: classic dual balanced armature studio reference IEM
- [D2 Custom-Fit Earphones](https://www.sensaphonics.com/products/d2iems): D2 dual dynamic custom IEMs with Dynamic Resonance Chamber
- [Custom In-Ear Monitors & Earphones](https://www.sensaphonics.com/collections/custom-in-ear-monitors-earphones): Main product collection: custom IEMs including 3DME, 3MAX, 2MAX, 2X-S

## Specialized IEM Solutions

- [221 Single-Ear Stereo Custom Earphone](https://www.sensaphonics.com/products/221): 221: true stereo single-ear IEM for unilateral hearing loss
